relations.name: Restore return suppression
relations.consequence: The BOOT1 wrapper returns the write result after restore and unlock.

relations.name: Partition cache and card-shadow commit
relations.consequence: Same cached partition bypasses the switch. The software cache and shadow keep prior values when CMD6 or CMD13 returns an error.

relations.name: Ordinary write
relations.consequence: The traced normal write checks capacity from the cached partition and submits CMD24 or CMD25. The CMD7 helper uses the card RCA and does not reset partition access.

relations.name: Walker result
relations.consequence: The new walker explicitly selects user partition and aborts on failure. The header/image wrappers propagate their BOOT1 wrapper return without separate restore-error handling.

scope: Bounded static ARM and mocked CPU-only replay. Physical card state after errors, writes to media, all callers and live recovery remain unverified.

reference.scope: Protocol naming/field correspondence only. Firmware calls selection1 boot1; this does not establish driver provenance.
